generation_matrix.model: Synthetic decodeComparisonModel: dim256, hidden704, layers1, heads4, kvheads2, context512, byte tokenizer, seed19. Quantize matrix parameters with existing test helpers; setup and quantization are outside timed generation.
generation_matrix.sampling: greedy, repeat penalty1, seed19; fixed-step tokenizer disables EOS
generation_matrix.protocol: GOMAXPROCS is set inside each leaf benchmark and planGenerationPrompt worker count is asserted. Two untimed completions are compared within each format before measurement. Cross-format completion equality is NOT claimed. Whole request generation includes scratch/KV/executor creation, prefill, decode, sampling and output decoding; model loading is excluded.
generation_matrix.superseded_results: post-singleexp-matrix-20261109.txt is retained as a diagnostic only: it set GOMAXPROCS in the parent benchmark rather than each leaf, so worker labels were not reliable. Do not use it for worker-count conclusions.

cpu_profiles.scope: Six separate processes: three formats x prefill-heavy(257/1) or decode-heavy(33/128), workers1. Benchtime3s includes Go benchmark calibration, setup and untimed checks in the process-wide profile. No claim of pure decode-only timing.

q4_candidate.hypothesis: Replace two-weight lookup-table loads with signed-nibble shifts and integer-to-float conversion, retaining the existing fully unrolled 64-element dot structure and reduction order.
q4_candidate.correctness: All 256 packed-byte decode values match the existing table. 256 full blocks with deterministic ordinary finite inputs match dotQ4Block64 bit-for-bit. No claim about full-kernel tails, wide sums or exceptional floating-point values.
q4_candidate.timing_protocol: Same complete 64-element block per call, same dynamic function-call layer, single GOMAXPROCS=1, 256 deterministic blocks, 1024 sweeps per leg, 32 pairs alternating order, warmup both paths, three fresh processes. No dispatch or omitted-tail mismatch.
q4_candidate.decision: rejected; keep the production lookup table
q4_candidate.generation_comparison: Not performed: the matched block probe is already substantially slower. No runtime integration or whole-generation speedup is claimed.
q4_candidate.cause: Not established. These measurements do not isolate conversion instruction throughput from load behavior, scheduling or code layout.

memory_observations.scope: Go sampled alloc_objects/alloc_space across the profiling process, including benchmark harness and setup; not RSS, peak memory or retained live bytes.
memory_observations.escape_analysis: go build -gcflags=-m reports cmd/monolith/monolith.go:4464:40: func literal escapes to heap. Full build diagnostics are retained locally at runs/post-singleexp-escape.log.
memory_observations.next_hypothesis: Investigate escaping per-invocation quantized-kernel callbacks and reuse call state, preserving admission limits, worker join and reference-clearing invariants. Allocation reductions are not automatically wall-clock speedups.

limitations: Single Apple M4 host/toolchain and small synthetic cache-resident model; not a ranking of real-model f32/q8/q4 performance.
Matrix repeats are in one process and fixed format order; they are descriptive baselines, not matched candidate speedup evidence.
CPU sample shares are not directly removable wall-clock time.
Raw pprof and test executables are retained locally under ignored runs/; textual summaries, source and timing arrays are retained in the repository.
No new real-model measurements, no production changes, and no claim of a general optimization ceiling.
